items.title: Cards on grey: shadow, frame, or nothing?

today.text: On white, the white cards almost disappear into the background.

proposed.text: A, no treatment. On grey, the white cards already show where they end. B and C are for comparison only.

items.title: A card title is hidden in the fan

today.text: The front card covers the left 40% of the card behind it, exactly where its title starts. Without hover you only see "…ings".

proposed.text: Open the fan to ±72% and shorten the text area (right: 90px), so all three titles show at rest.

items.title: Accent word in blue on saturated yellow

today.text: Yellow and blue both used for emphasis, fighting over one word. 4.72:1 leaves no margin for a thin serif.

proposed.text: The accent word in ink (13.3:1). The serif and the position already set it apart.

items.title: Tabs on mobile in a single row

today.text: Four tabs on two rows at 375.

proposed.text: One row from 320 to 480. Tap height stays 44px.

items.change: tabs.css @media (max-width:480px) { .tabs { flex-wrap: nowrap; gap: 2px } .tabs span { font-size: 11px; min-height: 44px } }

items.title: Headings mix Title Case and sentence case

today.text: Pricing Plans / Frequently asked questions / Contact Us

proposed.text: Pricing plans / Frequently asked questions / Contact us

items.change: pricing.html, faq.html, contact.html: headings to sentence case
